title: Concurrent Futures As Completed
prompt:
Iterate over futures as they finish execution in real time.

Starting code:

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, ___

with ThreadPoolExecutor() as ex:
    futures = [ex.submit(work, i) for i in range(5)]
    for fut in as_completed(futures):
        print(fut.result())
sample_solution:
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

with ThreadPoolExecutor() as ex:
    futures = [ex.submit(work, i) for i in range(5)]
    for fut in as_completed(futures):
        print(fut.result())
